programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: For over 100 years Mataatua wharepuni was uprooted from its home soil in Whakatāne, over 100 years in which Ngāti Awa could not be there to keep its fires burning. Ngāti Awa still mourns. Let the ancestral carvings of the house that came home arise! Arise! (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: 100 years ago, land was stolen from the tribe of Ngati-Oneone in the East Coast of New Zealand. The land was taken from them to build a port, now known as, ‘Gisborne Port.’ After years of debating to give the land back and not being heard, the decedents of Rawiri Te Eketu o te Rangi have decided to march and take occupation over the land that is rightfully theirs. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: A proud son of Ngāti Manawa, war veteran Richard Dargaville, once a soldier for the New Zealand Army, he remains forever a soldier for te ao Māori. His service reflects not just commitment to a nation, but a deep dedication to whakapapa, identity, and the ongoing struggles and strengths of his whānau and wider Māori communities. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: Through the act of karanga, we traverse both the physical and spiritual realms, guided by ancestral voices that echo through time. This sacred practice is far more than a ritual—it is a powerful form of cultural expression that binds the living with those who have passed on. Within the context of Whiria te hono, a distinguished collective of kaikaranga from Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei, the spiritual and practical responsibilities of this tradition are deeply honoured and carefully upheld. These wāhine carry the weight of generations with each call, embodying the values, stories, and mana of their iwi. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: Charlie Rahiri describes himself as a reluctant iwi leader. But he was destined by his kaumātua to lead his iwi, Ngati Ranginui. He’s a direct descendant of Iwi chief Paraone Koikoi who surrendered his guns and pouches to the colonial office in 1864, only to be back in his kainga in Taumata three years later fighting for his land by pulling up survey pegs. We look at the changing role of a Māori Leader in Modern society through the eyes of Charlie Rahiri. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: From haka to anthem—Te Arawa shares the stories behind powerful songs that preserve our past and move hearts worldwide. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: The life and practice of Kumeroa Gregory, a skilled rongoā and weaving practitioner. Raised in Te Urewera under the guidance of her kuia and koroua, Ruakenana, Kumeroa’s journey took a significant turn in 1970 when she moved north. (R)

programme.desc: we cross the waters of Tauranga Moana to the island of Matakana. programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: For over 100 years Mataatua wharepuni was uprooted from its home soil in Whakatāne, over 100 years in which Ngāti Awa could not be there to keep its fires burning. Ngāti Awa still mourns. Let the ancestral carvings of the house that came home arise! Arise! (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: 100 years ago, land was stolen from the tribe of Ngati-Oneone in the East Coast of New Zealand. The land was taken from them to build a port, now known as, ‘Gisborne Port.’ After years of debating to give the land back and not being heard, the decedents of Rawiri Te Eketu o te Rangi have decided to march and take occupation over the land that is rightfully theirs. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: A proud son of Ngāti Manawa, war veteran Richard Dargaville, once a soldier for the New Zealand Army, he remains forever a soldier for te ao Māori. His service reflects not just commitment to a nation, but a deep dedication to whakapapa, identity, and the ongoing struggles and strengths of his whānau and wider Māori communities. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: Through the act of karanga, we traverse both the physical and spiritual realms, guided by ancestral voices that echo through time. This sacred practice is far more than a ritual—it is a powerful form of cultural expression that binds the living with those who have passed on. Within the context of Whiria te hono, a distinguished collective of kaikaranga from Ngāti Whātua Ōrākei, the spiritual and practical responsibilities of this tradition are deeply honoured and carefully upheld. These wāhine carry the weight of generations with each call, embodying the values, stories, and mana of their iwi. (R)

programme.desc: Charlie Rahiri describes himself as a reluctant iwi leader. But he was destined by his kaumātua to lead his iwi, Ngati Ranginui. He’s a direct descendant of Iwi chief Paraone Koikoi who surrendered his guns and pouches to the colonial office in 1864, only to be back in his kainga in Taumata three years later fighting for his land by pulling up survey pegs. We look at the changing role of a Māori Leader in Modern society through the eyes of Charlie Rahiri. (R)

programme.title: rage
programme.desc: Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

programme.title: Dr Ann's Secret Lives
programme.desc: In the middle of the jungle in Borneo Dr Ann Jones and a team of scientists search high and low for a mammal as big as a dog and covered in scales. One of the world's most trafficked animal; the weird and wonderful pangolin.

programme.title: Take 5
programme.desc: You can learn a lot about someone from their mixtape. Zan Rowe joins Keith Urban in Nashville as curiosity and creativity filters through the playlist of an artist with profoundly eclectic taste. A story of never giving up.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce returns with the specialists for a second visit to the Devon coast home of the cadets of the Britannia Royal Naval College, Dartmouth.

Sarah Ferguson presents Australia's premier daily current affairs program, delivering agenda-setting public affairs journalism and interviews that hold the powerful to account. Plus political analysis from Jacob Greber.

programme.title: News Breakfast
programme.desc: News Breakfast gives you the morning advantage. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, sport with Catherine Murphy and weather with Nate Byrne. Don't just start your day informed, start your day in front.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings
programme.desc: Stay in the know with what's going on this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Kathryn Robinson.

programme.title: Gruen
programme.desc: Tonight on Gruen, we get lost in Aldi and buy a bottle of CLR, a packet of talking crumpets and the latest must-have fashion accessory - a water bottle. Wil, Todd and Russel are joined by Karen Ferry and Renata Yannoulis.

programme.title: Gruen
programme.desc: We improve urine with Swisse vitamins, improve smiles with Colgate's purple goo and improve scabbing off parents with Wise. Plus, we try to save Big W. Wil, Todd and Russel are joined by Jessica Sutanto and Lauren Zonfrillo.

programme.title: Grand Designs New Zealand
programme.desc: An environmentally-committed young couple in Christchurch buck convention by going back to the future with a centuries-old building material.

programme.title: ABC News At Noon
programme.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

programme.title: Recipe of the Year
programme.desc: It's the semi-final and a secret twist surprises the home cooks as they compete to create their best weekend recipes - from brunch, to a Sunday roast.

programme.title: Dustfall
programme.desc: When Tig finally discovers who is murdering the rapists, she must decide if she can turn a blind eye to a private quest for justice.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: Murdoch's investigation into the death of a roller-skating champion takes him into a world of aggressive and ruthlessly competitive young women.

programme.title: Old People's Home for 4 Year Olds
programme.desc: The participants put on a big show at the retirement village, they're retested by the experts to find out if their wellbeing has improved, and we see how their friendships are flourishing months later. (Season Final)

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: An extraordinary double search within one family: a sister looking for her brother Keith to tell him the truth about their father, and a further search with Keith to find out more about the birth mother he never knew. (Final)

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and the team head to Yorkshire where a packed house awaits at Saltaire's Victoria Hall. Amongst the family treasures is a doodle by Lowry worth a small fortune.

programme.title: Hard Quiz
programme.desc: It's a Hard Quiz lineup for the ages: Tom Gleeson grills experts in the kakapo (it's a flightless bird), Theseus (he's a mythical Greek), calculus (it's a field of mathematics), and Neighbours (it's Neighbours).

programme.title: ABC News
programme.desc: News from where we live. ABC News Tasmania brings you the day's top stories, exclusive investigations and original reporting on the issues that matter to Tasmanians. Presented by Guy Stayner.

programme.title: Gardening Australia
programme.desc: Costa and Hannah visit an eco-village to see how people and plants are growing together. Hannah plants five set-and-forget vegies, Costa goes foraging and visits a garden benefiting refugees, and we meet ecologist John Seed.

programme.title: Numberblocks

programme.title: Mittens & Pants

programme.title: Fantus And The Machines
programme.desc: Fantus sees how the all-in-one crane trucks load, unload and transports heavy goods.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Mummy Pig is making everyone pancakes. George and Peppa gobble theirs up noisily. Daddy Pig thinks that he's a bit of an expert at pancake flipping but he flips his pancake so high that it sticks to the kitchen ceiling.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: Sing and dance to 'Captain's Magic Buttons' Captain Feathersword's pirate vest has magical buttons! When pressed, he becomes a copy robot, copying Lachy, Anthony, and Caterina- join the fun!

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: After spending the night putting together the bed instead of sleeping in it, the farmer has a lie in and Bitzer is in charge of making sure his master's rest is uninterrupted.

programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programme.desc: Judy is looking after the school pet gerbil, which is accidentally released by Paddington. Paddington and Judy search the house and Mr Curry's garden looking for it.

programme.desc: The Iron Friends must stop delivery bots that have gone rogue.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Armadylan tries to fix a museum artifact without telling the PJ Masks.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Spidey saves the day after Green Goblin's device forces people to dance!

programme.title: Disney Jr.'s Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel uses magic to clean her room.

programme.title: Flower & Flour
programme.desc: When Aunty Mia and Aunty Nina need the alley wall repainted, Flower volunteers herself and her friends for the task. Can Flower decide what to paint in time for the grand reveal, even with Flour's energetic help?

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Today, Mummy Pig has a work trip to promote her new book. In her absence, Peppa spends the day pretending to be Mummy Pig.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes guide a young Strawberrisaurus to find the courage to perform a special friendship dance that will help them find a lifelong playmate.

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: The cadets are competing in an epic beach race and Gemma is determined to beat Pounce to the finish - until an emergency breaks out in the last leg.

programme.title: HexVets And Magic Pets

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo help Preston pretend to be a famous famous character with some very demanding fans!

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
programme.desc: Andy blasts off on an aquatic adventure to California to see how kelp forests in the wild deal with urchins. Along the way, he meets a fish called a garibaldi and some sea otters.

programme.title: Play School
programme.desc: Hunter and Luke give homes to their animal creations and use a world globe to discover where they are usually found. Luke makes some chia puddings with some yummy runny maple syrup.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: When James plans a cafe makeover for the Wholefish Cafe, he becomes over-zealous which leads to a series of events that cause a fire.

programme.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts

programme.title: The Woohoos!
programme.desc: When the Woohoos sees ants carrying items much larger than them, they wonder if the tiny insects have superpowers. They find out that ants use teamwork to do amazing things, including turning themselves into a bridge!

programme.title: Guess How Much I Love You
programme.desc: One summer's day Little Field Mouse is very excited to show Little Nutbrown Hare a very pretty flower! She lets Little Nutbrown Hare borrow it but when it blows away Little Nutbrown Hare worries how his friend will react.

programme.title: Miffy and friends
programme.desc: When Mummy catches Miffy in the act of sneaking a snack even though she can't see her, Miffy comes to believe her mother has magic powers.

programme.title: The Sound Collector
programme.desc: It's a rainy day, so the Sound Collector creates a magic carpet ride for Mole!

programme.title: Mittens & Pants

programme.title: Mini Kids
programme.desc: The toddlers are visited by a parrot. Fantus helps a little tiger find its parent.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
